name: Names on Stones
summary: Three unmarked graves lie in the Potter's Field. Mori Shade wants each one matched to the villager who lost them.

stages.journal: Mori Shade has three unmarked graves in the Potter's Field and a ledger of grieving villagers. She wants each grave given a name.
stages.hint: Study the three tokens at the posts in the Potter's Field, then tell the right villager. Mori can place them from her ledger if you cannot.

stages.journal: All three graves have names, and three villagers know where their dead are.
The three posts stay blank. The field goes on forgetting.
